# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6 B3, the Ottoman interregnum after Ankara. Generated by gen_interregnum.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Marks a once-only event and fires it.
oe_ivr_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_ivr_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ivr.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly until the storyline has begun (main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly, gen_mainline_lock.py).
oe_ivr_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ivr_can_begin = yes oe_ml_free = yes } oe_ivr_begin = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Finds the claimants and fires the news.
oe_ivr_begin = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun
    oe_ivr_pick = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ivr_sultan } set_variable = { name = oe_ivr_sultan value = scope:oe_ivr_sultan } set_variable = oe_ivr_captured }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p1 exists = scope:oe_bet_p2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ivr_p1 value = scope:oe_bet_p1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ivr_p2 value = scope:oe_bet_p2 }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p3 } set_variable = { name = oe_ivr_p3 value = scope:oe_bet_p3 } }
        # The news names the first two claimants.
        set_variable = { name = oe_bet_c1 value = scope:oe_bet_p1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_bet_c2 value = scope:oe_bet_p2 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = oe_ivr_no_bet }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ivr.1
}

# BYZ scope. Claimants: scope:oe_bet_p1 the Ottoman ruler (an adult of the dynasty), then up to two more, oldest first:
# the captive sultan's sons, or (no captive) men of the dynasty in the Ottoman state or a state at war with it.
oe_ivr_pick = {
    dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= {
        random_character_in_dynasty = {
            limit = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned is_adult = yes NOT = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            save_scope_as = oe_ivr_sultan
        }
    }
    c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { if = { limit = { is_adult = yes dynasty ?= dynasty:ottomans_dynasty } save_scope_as = oe_bet_p1 } } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ivr_sultan }
        scope:oe_ivr_sultan = {
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p1 }
            ordered_child = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 }
            ordered_child = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p3 }
            }
            else = {
            ordered_child = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p1 }
            ordered_child = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 }
            ordered_child = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 2 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p3 }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p1 }
            ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 }
            ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p3 }
            }
            else = {
            ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p1 }
            ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 1 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 }
            ordered_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { is_adult = yes is_female = no NOT = { has_character_modifier = imprisoned } NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } owner ?= { OR = { this = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } } order_by = age_in_days position = 2 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_bet_p3 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Opens the bet (round 1) with the claimants found at the start.
oe_ivr_open = {
    var:oe_ivr_p1 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_p1 }
    var:oe_ivr_p2 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_p3 } var:oe_ivr_p3 = { save_scope_as = oe_bet_p3 } }
    oe_bet_open = { round = 1 }
    activate_situation = situation:oe_ivr_interregnum
}

# BYZ scope. Round-1 hook of the framework, monthly while the bet runs: the pool of events .4-.7.
oe_ivr_bet_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_evcd } }
        random = {
            chance = 25
            set_variable = { name = oe_ivr_evcd months = 4 }
            random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 has_variable = oe_bet_m var:oe_bet_m >= 6 var:oe_bet_m <= 30 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_done_4 } } oe_ivr_fire = { n = 4 } }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 oe_bet_alive_3 = yes has_variable = oe_bet_m var:oe_bet_m >= 48 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_done_5 } } oe_ivr_fire = { n = 5 } }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 oe_bet_backing = yes oe_bet_backed_leads = no has_variable = oe_bet_m var:oe_bet_m >= 24 OR = { AND = { oe_bet_leader_1 = yes var:oe_bet_s1 >= 60 } AND = { oe_bet_leader_2 = yes var:oe_bet_s2 >= 60 } AND = { oe_bet_leader_3 = yes var:oe_bet_s3 >= 60 } } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_done_6 } } oe_ivr_fire = { n = 6 } }
                10 = { trigger = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 1 oe_bet_backed_alive = yes oe_bet_backed_leads = no navy_size > 0 has_variable = oe_bet_m var:oe_bet_m >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_done_7 } } oe_ivr_fire = { n = 7 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The Treaty of Gallipoli.
oe_ivr_treaty = {
    set_variable = oe_ivr_treaty
    set_global_variable = oe_ivr_tribute_freed
    location:thessaloniki = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 塞萨洛尼基
    location:kassandreia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 卡桑德里亚
    location:mount_athos = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 阿索斯山
    location:polygyros = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 波利伊罗斯
    location:lake_volvi = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 沃尔维湖
    location:silivri = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 锡林布里亚
    location:corlu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 乔尔卢
    location:rodoscuk = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 雷德斯托
    location:kiyikoy = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 梅迪亚
    location:ahtopol = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 阿加索波利斯
    location:sozopol = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 索佐波尔
    location:anhialo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 安基阿洛斯
    location:burgas = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } }  # 布尔加斯
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_ask_varna } location:varna = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } change_location_owner = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_ceded } } }
    c:TUR = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes } }
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } }
    c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ivr_straits_pact years = 10 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ivr_treaty_op target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ivr_treaty_op target = c:BYZ } } }
    # The hostage: a young son of the captive sultan.
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_sultan }
        var:oe_ivr_sultan = { random_child = { limit = { is_adult = no owner ?= c:TUR } move_country = c:BYZ set_variable = oe_ivr_hostage } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. .6: back the prince who is neither the besieger nor the one we backed.
oe_ivr_switch_other = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_leader_2 = yes oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 3 } oe_bet_push = { n = 3 amount = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 1 oe_bet_leader_3 = yes oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 2 } oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_leader_1 = yes oe_bet_alive_3 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 3 } oe_bet_push = { n = 3 amount = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 2 oe_bet_leader_3 = yes oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 1 } oe_bet_push = { n = 1 amount = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_leader_1 = yes oe_bet_alive_2 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 2 } oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = 10 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_back ?= 3 oe_bet_leader_2 = yes oe_bet_alive_1 = yes } oe_bet_set_back = { n = 1 } oe_bet_push = { n = 1 amount = 10 } }
}

# BYZ scope. .8: the follow-up for the outcome.
oe_ivr_after_settlement = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bet_out_won has_variable = oe_bet_winner var:oe_bet_winner >= 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ivr.9 days = 30 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bet_out_lost has_variable = oe_bet_winner var:oe_bet_winner >= 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ivr.10 days = 30 } }
    else = { oe_ivr_finish = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. .9: backed the winner.
oe_ivr_reaffirm = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ivr_treaty } } oe_ivr_treaty = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 20 mutual = yes } }
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ivr_obedient_son target = c:BYZ } }
    oe_ivr_finish = yes
}
# BYZ scope. .10 a: pay tribute again under a buying-peace agreement.
oe_ivr_retribute = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_ivr_tribute_freed
    c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
    oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes
    oe_ivr_finish = yes
}
# BYZ scope. .10 b: about half of the ceded places go back.
oe_ivr_return_half = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_ceded }
        random = { chance = 50 change_location_owner = c:TUR remove_variable = oe_ivr_ceded }
    }
    oe_ivr_finish = yes
}
# BYZ scope. .10 c: refuse.
oe_ivr_refuse = {
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ivr_spurned target = c:BYZ } }
    remove_truce_with = c:TUR
    oe_ivr_finish = yes
}

# BYZ scope. The storyline is over.
oe_ivr_finish = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ivr_done
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_p1
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_p2
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_p3
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_no_bet
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_ask_varna
    remove_variable = oe_ivr_evcd
    oe_bet_close = yes
}
